learning_objective: 🎯 Develop core entrepreneurial and event management skills by collaborating to plan, organize, and execute a successful school-level Skill Exhibition!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A Kaushal Mela is a grand skill fair where students showcase their pre-vocational models, crafts, and tech projects. It is a brilliant platform to celebrate creativity and hands-on learning.
Every good project starts with math. Planning a Mela teaches us how to calculate expenses for materials, set reasonable prices for products, and track earnings so we don't overspend.
Organizing an event is too big for one person. Students must form dynamic committees for decoration, hospitality, marketing, and crowd control, making sure every team member has a clear job.
An inviting stall layout makes visitors stop and look. Arrangements must include neat banners, clean product tables, clear price labels, and enthusiastic students ready to explain their work!

fun_activity.title: 🏪 Mela Stall Masterplan
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are setting up a stall at the Kaushal Mela to sell handmade bamboo bookmarks. Sketch a top-down layout blueprint of your table and write down a list of four team duties needed to run it.

quick_recap: ⭐ Kaushal Mela is a practical platform to display vocational talents and innovative student ideas.
⭐ Event management requires detailed financial budgeting and organized team cooperation.
⭐ A well-designed, informative stall layout helps attract visitors and effectively sells concepts.
